title: Fix the List Loop
description: The program should print every element of a list using its indices. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 10, 20, and 30, one per line.
actualProblem: range(len(numbers) + 1) produces one index too many (0, 1, 2, 3), and numbers[3] does not exist for a 3-element list, raising an IndexError.
explanation: A list of length n has valid indices 0 through n-1. Looping with range(len(numbers)) produces exactly those indices, without going one step past the end.
